title.narrative: Technical assistance in developing clean cooking and reforestation innovation project for Madagascar

description.narrative: This project aims to improve the living and health conditions of the Malagasy population by development and adoption of innovative clean cooking solutions based on UNIDO's Market Enabling Framework (MEF) for stimulating private sector investments in industry and value chain for switching households from traditional fuels to clean and affordable cooking solutions at scale. The project will employ commercial players on board in a way that a new market for alternative clean cooking fuels and technologies are rapidly developed with least subsidy or public funds. The proposed project support the National Clean Cooking Transition Program initiated by the Government of Madagascar with an estimated budget of US$100 million.
